stages.title: 一、建立系統邊界與輸入帳
stages.titleEn: 1. Define the system boundary and input ledger
stages.description: 閱讀來源 Iridium constellation continuity and cross-linked architecture，找出本課機制與適用範圍。以自己的圖解標示：星間路由把總距離與逐跳處理相加；hop數相同也可能有不同幾何與時間。 將輸入逐項抄入有單位的表：合成每星間hop2000 km、處理0.5 ms；比較3與5 hops，c=300000 km/s；不含地面接入。 對每個量註明固定、改變、推導或未建模；將引用內容與教學假設分欄。
stages.descriptionEn: Read Iridium constellation continuity and cross-linked architecture to locate the mechanism and its scope. Draw your own model boundary: Inter-satellite paths sum propagation distance and per-hop processing; equal hop count does not guarantee equal geometry or delay. Transcribe the inputs into a unit-bearing ledger: Each synthetic intersatellite hop is2000 km plus0.5 ms processing; compare3/5 hops atc=300000 km/s, excluding ground access. Label each quantity fixed, changed, derived or unmodelled, separating sourced concepts from teaching assumptions.
